Sometimes I still have those moments where I think: Wait… this is actually my work? 🌊  
A few years ago, I never imagined that therapy would take me into the ocean.  
But over time, I started noticing something: the things we talk about in a therapy room often show up in the water too: fear, control, trust, connection, frustration and letting go.  
The difference is that in the ocean, you don’t just talk about them. You experience them.   
And that creates a completely different kind of opportunity for awareness, connection and change.  
Over the past few years, I’ve had the privilege of hosting 16(!) retreats around the world, bringing therapy, surfing and human connection together.  
But tbh, it still feels like the beginning.  
I’m incredibly curious about where this Ripple journey will take us next 💙🌎  
Curious about what Surf Therapy could look like for you?  
Comment RIPPLE below and I’ll send you more information.
